content.epew_uses_secure_verification_systems_to: EPEW uses secure verification systems to help protect supporters, entrepreneurs, and ecosystem integrity through identity validation and two-factor authentication.
content.two_factor_authentication_helps_secure_y: Two-factor authentication helps secure your EPEW account, protect participation activity, and reduce unauthorized access.
content.identity_verification_and_secure_authent: Identity verification and secure authentication are required before participating in the EPEW ecosystem.
